entities.name: Princess Lātūfuipeka Tukuʻaho
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Princess Lātūfuipeka is a Tongan royal and a member of the House of Tupou. The only daughter of Tupou VI, King of Tonga, Princess Lātūfuipeka was appointed Tonga's High Commissioner to Australia on 22 August 2012, after her father – High Commissioner until then – succeeded as the King of Tonga.
